Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，有委托分配给您。请尽快来伊波恩一楼找我一下。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, a commission has been assigned to you. Please come see me on the first floor of Eibon as soon as possible.

Content.SourceString: 明白了。
Content.LocalizedString: I see.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，我们现在在电玩城的娃娃机那边，买到糖果之后可以过来汇合。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, we're by the claw machines at the arcade. Come meet us after you get the candy.

Content.SourceString: 好的
Content.LocalizedString: Alright.

Content.SourceString: 遵命，首席管家先生
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, Head Butler, sir.

Content.SourceString: 好的
Content.LocalizedString: Alright.

Content.SourceString: 好的
Content.LocalizedString: Alright.

Content.SourceString: 明白了。
Content.LocalizedString: I see.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，晚餐已准备好。是否需要为您预留保温？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, dinner is ready. Would you like me to keep it warm for you?

Content.SourceString: 另：今天的餐后茶点由娜娜莉与塔吉多他们协助准备。还请鉴定师品尝时稍加留意，多多鼓励。
Content.LocalizedString: Also: Today's after-dinner treats were prepared with help from Nanally and Taygedo. Please pay special attention when tasting them, Appraiser, and offer plenty of encouragement.

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生辛苦了，我这就回去。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you for your work, Mr. Adler. I'll head back right away.

Content.SourceString: 好的。请鉴定师路上注意安全。
Content.LocalizedString: Very well. Safe travels, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，或许你现在有空吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I was wondering if you might be free at the moment?

Content.SourceString: 怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: What's wrong?

Content.SourceString: 鄙人在伊波恩前台发现了一张白鲸书店的会员卡，上面写着埃德嘉的名字。
Content.LocalizedString: I happened to find a Moby-Dick Bookstore membership card at Eibon's front desk with Edgar's name on it.

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉说过，今天要去水梨子大道上的白鲸书店。没了这张卡，不知道他有没有带够买书的钱。
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar mentioned he was heading to the Moby-Dick Bookstore on Davidia Avenue today. Without this card, I wonder if he brought enough money to purchase books.

Content.SourceString: 所以鄙人想，还是给他送过去比较好。
Content.LocalizedString: So I thought it would be better if I delivered it to him myself.

Content.SourceString: 只是正好有约定的委托，鄙人抽不开身……所以只好来问问鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just that I have a previously scheduled commission that I cannot step away from… so I had to come ask for the Appraiser's assistance.

Content.SourceString: 好的，我现在就去。
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, I'll go right away.

Content.SourceString: 看时间，这会儿他肯定还在书店。辛苦了，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Judging by the time, he should definitely still be at the bookstore. Thank you for your help, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 看时间，这会儿他肯定还在书店。辛苦了，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Judging by the time, he should definitely still be at the bookstore. Thank you for your help, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师最近有收到什么惊喜吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, have you received any pleasant surprises lately?

Content.SourceString: 惊喜？什么惊喜？
Content.LocalizedString: Surprises? What surprises?

Content.SourceString: Taygedo。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo.

Content.SourceString: 沉默.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: silence.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师不必紧张，只是最近娜娜莉他们……似乎有些忙碌？
Content.LocalizedString: Worry not, Appraiser. It's just that Nanally and the others… seem rather busy lately, don't they?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Everything's out in the open now.
I guess I can't hide it after all.

Content.SourceString: 看来阿德勒先生都知道了。
Content.LocalizedString: Seems like Adler already knows everything.

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉果然瞒不住。
Content.LocalizedString: Seems like Nanally can't keep a secret after all.

Content.SourceString: 喝咖啡.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: drinkingcoffee.jpg

Content.SourceString: 多亏他们的帮忙，这些天鄙人也悠闲了一些。
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks to their help, I have enjoyed some leisure time these past few days.

Content.SourceString: 能帮到阿德勒先生就是好事。
Content.LocalizedString: Anything that helps.

Content.SourceString: 那鄙人也该准备一些回礼才是。
Content.LocalizedString: Then I should prepare some gifts in return.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师有什么疑虑吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is something troubling you, Appraiser?

OptionText.LocalizedString: They didn't help for the gift

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉早雾他们帮助阿德勒先生并不是想要得到回礼。
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally, Sakiri, and the others didn't help you expecting anything in return.

Content.SourceString: 如果阿德勒先生准备了回礼，那么娜娜莉他们说不定又要为了这份回礼再准备一份大惊喜，然后阿德勒先生再准备回礼……
Content.LocalizedString: If you prepare gifts for them, Nanally and the others might feel obligated to prepare an even bigger surprise in return, and then you would feel compelled to give more gifts… and on and on it would go.

Content.SourceString: 不如从一开始阿德勒先生就接受这份「惊喜大礼」如何？
Content.LocalizedString: Why not accept their surprise gift from the start?

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师原来是这个意思，反倒是鄙人多虑了。
Content.LocalizedString: I see what you mean now, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 那么为了感谢鉴定师的帮助，鄙人会多准备一份晚间甜点的。
Content.LocalizedString: Then, to thank the Appraiser for your help, I shall prepare an extra evening dessert.

Content.SourceString: 那这不就又……
Content.LocalizedString: Wait, isn't this just the same problem again…

Content.SourceString: 这份甜点只是咨询费，并不是回礼。
Content.LocalizedString: This dessert is merely a consultation fee, not a return gift.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师不如接受这一份「不惊喜大礼」如何？
Content.LocalizedString: Why don't you accept this "non-surprise gift" instead, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 喝咖啡.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: drinkingcoffee.jpg

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生现在有空吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Adler, are you free right now?

Content.SourceString: 有空，鉴定师请说。
Content.LocalizedString: I am, Appraiser. Please, go ahead.

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生是怎么安排时间的呢？
Content.LocalizedString: How do you arrange your time?

Content.SourceString: 既能有条不紊地处理好伊波恩日常事务，还能随时应对突然的委托需求。
Content.LocalizedString: You manage Eibon's Daily affairs meticulously while still being able to take on unexpected commissions at any time.

Content.SourceString: 是有什么「秘诀」吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have some sort of secret technique?

Content.SourceString: 谈不上秘诀，常规事务皆是如此，只需要按照计划进行，并不需要多费心思。
Content.LocalizedString: I wouldn't call it a secret technique. Regular affairs are straightforward. I simply follow the plan without overthinking things.

Content.SourceString: 至于突发事件，事先若是有预案准备的话，也不难处理。
Content.LocalizedString: As for unexpected situations, they're also not difficult to handle if I've prepared contingency plans in advance.

Content.SourceString: 虽是这么说，鄙人也不过是多经历了些才能说出这样的大话。
Content.LocalizedString: Despite what I just said, I'm merely speaking from experience. It would be presumptuous to claim anything more.

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生太谦虚了。
Content.LocalizedString: You're being too modest.

Content.SourceString: 原来如此。
Content.LocalizedString: I see.

Content.SourceString: 突发事件的预案准备是？
Content.LocalizedString: What kind of contingency plans do you prepare for unexpected situations?

Content.SourceString: 只是一些常规预案。
Content.LocalizedString: Just some standard contingency measures, that's all.

Content.SourceString: 《娜娜莉与易聘屋纠纷可能产生的53种后果及应对措施》
Content.LocalizedString: 53 Potential Consequences and Countermeasures for Disputes Between Nanally and EZ-Hire

Content.SourceString: 《娜娜莉帮派大计第127版》
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally's Gang Master Plan, Version 127

Content.SourceString: 《柯林斯家族人员扩张对伊波恩生意影响预案》
Content.LocalizedString: Contingency Plan for the Impact of Colucci Family Expansion on Eibon's Business

Content.SourceString: 《伊波恩古董店经营策略调整计划新版》
Content.LocalizedString: Updated - Strategic Adjustment for Eibon Management

Content.SourceString: 《改善孩子挑食的一百种方式》
Content.LocalizedString: 100 Ways to Improve Children's Picky Eating Habits

Content.SourceString: 不会还有吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Don't tell me there's more…

Content.SourceString: 还有些，不过似乎达到短信上限了。
Content.LocalizedString: There are more, but I seem to have reached the message character limit.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师若是感兴趣的话，鄙人这里还有纸质版。
Content.LocalizedString: If the Appraiser is interested, I have paper copies available as well.

Content.SourceString: 期待.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: <Blue>「异象盘点第148期——管家，详情请戳……」</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Blue>"Anomalies Report #148—Butler, tap here for details…"</>

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，发错了。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, sent that by mistake.

Content.SourceString: 无妨。
Content.LocalizedString: No problem.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师想了解「管家」？
Content.LocalizedString: So the Appraiser is interested in learning about butlers?

OptionText.LocalizedString: I'd like to be a butler too

Content.SourceString: 有点兴趣。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm somewhat interested.

Content.SourceString: 我也想当管家。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd like to be a butler too.

Content.SourceString: 有些好奇。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm rather curious.

Content.SourceString: 「管家」根据手腕和手套的精细程度，划分等级，从上级往下级分类为金、银、铜三色，级别越高，清洁的效率和范围就越大。
Content.LocalizedString: Butlers are classified according to the precision of their wrist movements and glove quality, divided into three levels from highest to lowest: Gold, Silver, and Bronze. The higher the class, the greater their cleaning efficiency and range of operation.

Content.SourceString: 尝试下新职业也未尝不可。
Content.LocalizedString: Trying a new profession isn't such a bad idea.

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生跟管家算是同行吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Would you consider yourself to be in the same line of work as the butlers?

Content.SourceString: 金边管家可称呼为恰帕先生/女士，银边家政官称呼为尤加利先生/女士，而铜边为大卫先生/小姐。
Content.LocalizedString: Golden Edge Butlers are addressed as Mister or Miss Chappa, Silver Edge Butlers as Mister or Miss Yugari, and Bronze Edge Butlers as Mister or Miss David.

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生有什么建议吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have any advice, Adler?

Content.SourceString: 就工作性质而言，倒也算得上是同行了。
Content.LocalizedString: As far as the nature of the work goes, I suppose we could be considered in the same line of work.

Content.SourceString: 鄙人有幸跟一位金边家政官恰帕先生共事过，是一位相当称职的管家。
Content.LocalizedString: I had the honor of working with a Golden Edge Butler, Mr. Chappa, who was an exceptionally competent butler.

Content.SourceString: 鄙人这边有些参考资料，鉴定师如有需要可以随时找我。
Content.LocalizedString: I have some reference materials on hand, Appraiser. Feel free to ask me for them anytime you need.

Content.SourceString: 听说家政官协会似乎想聘请阿德勒先生？
Content.LocalizedString: I heard the Butler Association is looking to recruit you, Adler?

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生对他的评价很高啊。
Content.LocalizedString: You seem to hold Mr. Chappa in high regard, Adler.

Content.SourceString: 那伊波恩的管家要做什么呢？
Content.LocalizedString: So what would Eibon's Butler do?

Content.SourceString: 确实有这么一说，不过鄙人并无跳槽的打算。
Content.LocalizedString: Indeed, there has been such talk, but I have no intention of changing employers.

Content.SourceString: 海特洛市的金边家政官值得这样的评价，鄙人也从它身上学到了许多。
Content.LocalizedString: The Golden Edge Butlers of Hethereau truly deserve such high praise. I've learned a great deal from him myself.

Content.SourceString: 早上开门后准备餐食，上午清扫店内，下午整合信息，晚上复盘，如有委托需要归档记录。
Content.LocalizedString: In the morning, we open the shop and prepare meals. Forenoon is for cleaning the premises, while afternoons are dedicated to compiling Info. Evenings are spent reviewing the day's activities, and any commissions must be properly documented and archived.

Content.SourceString: 家政官协会定期会举行交流会，与会成员皆是杰出的管家……同行们。
Content.LocalizedString: The Butler Association holds regular exchange meetings where distinguished butlers… people in the profession, gather.

Content.SourceString: 再详细的话，准备餐食时，如果是小姐宿醉，那就需要准备一些解酒的食物。早雾和娜娜莉都不太喜欢蔬菜，不过放在三明治里也能接受，埃德嘉不挑食只是吃的较少，需要留心，塔吉多倒是最简单的，鉴定师也是。
Content.LocalizedString: To be more specific about meal preparation, if Hotori has a hangover, I need to prepare food that helps with alcohol recovery. Sakiri and Nanally aren't fond of vegetables, though they'll tolerate them in sandwiches. Edgar isn't picky but eats very little, so I need to keep an eye on him. Taygedo is actually the simplest to accommodate, as is the Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 这样的交流于鄙人而言也是一种提升。
Content.LocalizedString: Such exchanges are also a form of personal development for me.

Content.SourceString: 那我还是做鉴定师比较好。
Content.LocalizedString: I think I'm better off sticking with being an Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 有阿德勒先生在的伊波恩，真好啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Eibon is truly blessed to have you.

Content.SourceString: 多谢鉴定师夸赞。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you for your kind words, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 能在伊波恩遇到大家，也是鄙人的荣幸。
Content.LocalizedString: It is my honor to have met everyone here at Eibon as well.

Content.SourceString: 开心.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: happy.jpg

Content.SourceString: 炭团送来了礼物，这一份留给鉴定师的。
Content.LocalizedString: Coal Lump has brought some gifts, and this one is for you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: <Red>图片。</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Red>Image.</>

Content.SourceString: 炭团的礼物？
Content.LocalizedString: A gift from Coal Lump?

Content.SourceString: 是帮忙解决一些麻烦事的回礼。
Content.LocalizedString: It's a thank-you gift for helping resolve some troublesome matters.

Content.SourceString: 歧骸们都很喜欢阿德勒先生呢。
Content.LocalizedString: The oddities seem to really like you, Adler.

Content.SourceString: 或许会有不喜欢阿德勒先生的歧骸吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder if there are any oddities who don't like you, Adler?

Content.SourceString: 当然。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course.

Content.SourceString: 大部分歧骸都很友善，只是表达的习惯与我们有些不同。
Content.LocalizedString: Most oddities are quite friendly, they just have different ways of expressing themselves than we do.

Content.SourceString: 但也囿于语言间的隔阂，在面对一些高危险性的歧骸时，摩擦和争斗总是难以避免的。
Content.LocalizedString: However, due to the barriers in communication, when dealing with some of the more dangerous oddities, friction and conflict are inevitably difficult to avoid.

Content.SourceString: 也有的歧骸对所有人都很友好。
Content.LocalizedString: Some oddities are friendly to everyone.

Content.SourceString: 纳库佩达
Content.LocalizedString: Nacupeda

Content.SourceString: 作为海特洛市的吉祥物，纳库佩达确实是非常亲人的歧骸了。
Content.LocalizedString: As the mascot of Hethereau, Nacupeda is indeed one of the most people-friendly oddities around.

Content.SourceString: 纳库佩达也有讨厌的人吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Even Nacupeda must have people they dislike, right?

Content.SourceString: 疑惑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 纳库佩达会讨厌的人……
Content.LocalizedString: People Nacupeda would dislike…

Content.SourceString: 愿闻其详。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd like to hear more about that, if you don't mind.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Anyone who secretly takes his Coins
People who say wishes on him don't come true
People who make wishes late at night

Content.SourceString: 偷偷把纳库佩达的硬币都捞走的人，一个都不留下。
Content.LocalizedString: Anyone who secretly takes all of Nacupeda's Coins without leaving a single one behind.

Content.SourceString: 当着纳库佩达的面说许愿不灵的人吧。
Content.LocalizedString: People who say wishes don't come true right in front of Nacupeda, I'd say.

Content.SourceString: 深夜还要来许愿的人，强迫纳库佩达加班。
Content.LocalizedString: People who come to make wishes late at night, forcing Nacupeda to work overtime.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师说的有理，如果纳库佩达生气的话……
Content.LocalizedString: The Appraiser makes a good point. If Nacupeda were to get angry…

Content.SourceString: 就会变成圆鼓鼓的纳库佩达？
Content.LocalizedString: Would they turn into a round, puffy Nacupeda?

Content.SourceString: 思考.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: thinking.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师在忙吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you busy, Appraiser?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Are we going out of business?!

Content.SourceString: 不忙。
Content.LocalizedString: Not busy.

Content.SourceString: 疑惑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 难道伊波恩要倒闭了吗？！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't tell me Eibon is going out of business?!

Content.SourceString: 暂时还没有这个危机。
Content.LocalizedString: We're not facing that kind of crisis just yet.

Content.SourceString: 并不是什么大事。
Content.LocalizedString: It's nothing serious.

Content.SourceString: 大概是天气的原因，早雾有些挑食，娜娜莉也更偏好肉类，埃德嘉惯常吃得较少。
Content.LocalizedString: Perhaps it's because of the weather, but Sakiri has become somewhat picky with food, Nanally has been favoring meat more, and Edgar is eating less than usual, as always.

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩的食谱需要更新一下了。
Content.LocalizedString: I think it's time we update Eibon's menu.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Sorry to trouble you again, Adler.

Content.SourceString: 又麻烦阿德勒先生了。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry to trouble you again, Adler.

Content.SourceString: 不算什么麻烦事，烹饪也算是鄙人的喜好之一。
Content.LocalizedString: It's no trouble at all. Cooking happens to be one of my personal pleasures.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师有什么偏好的口味吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have any particular taste preferences, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 咔叽玛一类的快餐？
Content.LocalizedString: Like Clicky Fast Food?

Content.SourceString: 像椒麻代理人这样的吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Something like Pepper's Ambassador, I guess.

Content.SourceString: 似乎……没什么口味偏好，只要是好吃的都可以。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't seem to have… any particular preference. Anything that tastes good works for me.

Content.SourceString: 既方便食用，又能很快提供能量。
Content.LocalizedString: It's convenient to eat and provides energy quickly.

Content.SourceString: 热腾腾的米饭和新鲜食材制作的各色佳肴，再配一碗小火慢炖的清汤。
Content.LocalizedString: Steaming hot rice with various delicious dishes made from fresh ingredients, accompanied by a bowl of slow-simmered clear soup.

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生做的菜都很好吃。
Content.LocalizedString: Everything you cook is delicious.

Content.SourceString: 脆嫩多汁的炸鸡，冒着热气的炸薯条和加冰的汽水……
Content.LocalizedString: Crispy and juicy fried chicken, steaming hot french fries, and ice-cold soda…

Content.SourceString: 跟好友家人一起，坐下来慢慢吃的才算是正餐。
Content.LocalizedString: A proper meal is one where you sit down and take your time eating with friends and family.

Content.SourceString: 开心.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: happy.jpg

Content.SourceString: 这大概就是幸福的具象化吧。
Content.LocalizedString: This must be what happiness looks like in physical form.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师的意见也很重要，这次的菜谱调整也会考虑到鉴定师的口味的。
Content.LocalizedString: Your opinion is also important, Appraiser. I'll definitely take your preferences into account when adjusting the menu this time.

Content.SourceString: 谢谢阿德勒先生。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you.

Content.SourceString: 期待阿德勒先生的新菜品。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm looking forward to your new dishes.

Content.SourceString: 开心.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: happy.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师好。
Content.LocalizedString: Good day, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 再次介绍一下，鄙人是伊波恩的管家，阿德勒。
Content.LocalizedString: Allow me to introduce myself again. I am Adler, the butler of Eibon.

Content.SourceString: 在伊波恩的生活有任何问题，鉴定师都可以随时问我。
Content.LocalizedString: If you have any questions about life at Eibon, please feel free to ask me anytime, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 好的，阿德勒先生。
Content.LocalizedString: Certainly.

Content.SourceString: 收到.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: received.jpg

Content.SourceString: 那鄙人就不过多叨扰了，鉴定师可自行安排。
Content.LocalizedString: Then I shall not intrude any further. Please feel free to make your own arrangements, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 希望鉴定师在伊波恩能拥有一段美好生活。
Content.LocalizedString: I hope you will enjoy a wonderful life here at Eibon, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 喝咖啡.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: drinkingcoffee.jpg

Content.SourceString: 第一次处理异象委托，鉴定师感觉如何？
Content.LocalizedString: How do you feel about handling your first Anomaly Commission, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 轻轻松松。
Content.LocalizedString: Piece of cake.

Content.SourceString: 简简单单。
Content.LocalizedString: Nice and simple.

Content.SourceString: 有些勉强。
Content.LocalizedString: It was somewhat challenging.

Content.SourceString: 那就好，看来鉴定师适应得很快。
Content.LocalizedString: Excellent. It seems you're adapting quite quickly, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 无妨，毕竟是第一次处理委托。
Content.LocalizedString: No need to worry. After all, this was your first commission.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师已经做得很好了。
Content.LocalizedString: You've done very well, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩接到的第一件委托是什么样的呢？
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder what the first commission for Eibon was?

Content.SourceString: 第一件委托……来自一个孩子。
Content.LocalizedString: The first commission… came from a child.

Content.SourceString: 孩子？
Content.LocalizedString: A child?

Content.SourceString: 疑惑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 那个孩子拜托我们调查桥间地的冰淇淋车。
Content.LocalizedString: A child has asked us to investigate an ice cream cart at Bridge Crossings.

Content.SourceString: 「碎雪的冰淇淋是怎么产生的呢？拜托拜托我真的很想知道！」
Content.LocalizedString: "How is Blizzi's ice cream made? Please, please, I really want to know!"

Content.SourceString: 至于报酬……
Content.LocalizedString: As for the payment…

Content.SourceString: 一共是<Red>100方斯</>。
Content.LocalizedString: That will be <Red>100 Fons</>.

OptionText.LocalizedString: The price of a single ice cream.

Content.LocalizedString: 100 Fons? That's it?

Content.SourceString: 一支冰淇淋的价格。
Content.LocalizedString: The price of a single ice cream.

Content.SourceString: 惊讶.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: surprised.jpg

Content.SourceString: 是的，刚好够买一支碎雪冰淇淋。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, just enough to buy one Blizzi Ice Cream.

Content.SourceString: 这样的委托，伊波恩也会接吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Does Eibon really accept commissions like this?

Content.SourceString: 虽然只是一件小事，但对于那时候的伊波恩来说，这是第一笔生意。
Content.LocalizedString: Although it seemed trivial, for Eibon at that time, this was our very first business.

Content.SourceString: 委托不论大小，只要报酬合理，伊波恩都会接受。
Content.LocalizedString: Regardless of size, Eibon accepts all commissions as long as the compensation is reasonable.

Content.SourceString: 接了小委托，那些大委托自然也会找上门来。
Content.LocalizedString: Take on small commissions, and the larger ones will naturally find their way to your door.

Content.SourceString: 原来是这样。
Content.LocalizedString: I see…

Content.SourceString: 不过阿德勒先生怎么知道，很快就会有大委托呢？
Content.LocalizedString: But how did you know that big commissions would come so quickly?

Content.SourceString: 虽说只是100方斯，可那孩子身上的装饰品可是来自兰德里柯呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Even though it was just 100 Fons, that child was wearing accessories from Landric.

Content.SourceString: 喝咖啡.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: drinkingcoffee.jpg

Content.SourceString: 震惊.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: shocked.jpg

Content.SourceString: 「美味炼金术」餐厅在呗果上发通告说主厨凯尼斯进修去了。
Content.LocalizedString: Delichemy restaurant posted an announcement on Bagel saying that Chef Kenneth has gone for further training.

Content.SourceString: 他甚至还打着让所有食客都能品尝到美食这样冠冕堂皇的旗号准备出书，这一切真是……
Content.LocalizedString: He's even planning to publish a book under the grandiose banner of "making delicious food accessible to all diners." This whole thing is just…

OptionText.LocalizedString: I'm at a loss for words.

Content.SourceString: 我决定以后都不光顾这家餐厅了。
Content.LocalizedString: I think I'd stay away from this restaurant.

Content.SourceString: 我要去呗果发帖子揭发这个人。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm going to expose this fraud on Bagel.

Content.SourceString: 不知道该怎么形容，为什么凯尼斯这样的人却……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm at a loss for words… how could someone like Kenneth…

Content.SourceString: 关于凯尼斯此人，异象管理局一定会妥善处理，鉴定师放心即可。
Content.LocalizedString: Rest assured, the Bureau of Anomaly Control will handle Kenneth's case appropriately. You need not concern yourself with it any further.

Content.SourceString: 像凯尼斯这样的委托人，伊波恩自成立以来也遇到不少，其中不乏比凯尼斯地位更高的人士。
Content.LocalizedString: Since its establishment, Eibon has encountered many clients like Kenneth, including those of even higher status than him.

Content.SourceString: 试图通过投机取巧的方式不劳而获，所窃取的成果也不过是暂时的。
Content.LocalizedString: Those who attempt to reap rewards without effort through shortcuts and tricks will find that their ill-gotten gains are merely temporary.

Content.SourceString: 至少这次过后，凯尼斯的味觉已经彻底消失了。
Content.LocalizedString: At the very least, after this incident, Kenneth has completely lost his sense of taste.

Content.SourceString: 希望凯尼斯能记住这次教训。
Content.LocalizedString: I hope Kenneth will remember this lesson.

Content.SourceString: 严肃.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: serious.jpg

Content.SourceString: 不过委托人在描述需求时如果有所隐瞒或者是欺骗的话，于我们而言，确实会有些许麻烦。
Content.LocalizedString: However, it does cause us some trouble when clients conceal or misrepresent their needs during the consultation process.

Content.SourceString: 有什么技巧吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Any tips you can share?

Content.SourceString: 拜托了阿德勒老师。
Content.LocalizedString: Please teach me, Adler.

Content.SourceString: 请赐教.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: teachme.jpg

Content.SourceString: 只是一些经验罢了。
Content.LocalizedString: Just drawing from some experience, that's all.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师在处理委托时，不妨先记住委托人的最终诉求，先撇去那些来自委托人的自我描述，再加以实际调查，或许能找到新的思路。
Content.LocalizedString: When handling commissions, an Appraiser should first remember the client's ultimate goal. Set aside their self-descriptions, conduct your own investigation, and you might discover a fresh perspective.

Content.SourceString: 当然这些也只是在下的愚见，鉴定师这次已经做得非常好了。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, these are merely my humble opinions. You've already done exceptionally well with this case, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 原来如此.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: Isee.jpg

Content.SourceString: 若是以后鉴定师有什么拿不准的地方，可以随时向我询问。
Content.LocalizedString: If you ever find yourself uncertain about anything in the future, Appraiser, please don't hesitate to ask me for advice.

Content.SourceString: 学习.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: studying.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师有看到塔吉多吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, have you seen Taygedo around?

Content.SourceString: 湛望角回来后塔吉多似乎有些闷闷不乐。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo seems a bit down in the dumps since returning from Azure Vista.

Content.SourceString: 今早起就没看到塔吉多了。
Content.LocalizedString: I haven't seen Taygedo at all since this morning.

Content.SourceString: 大概是第一次遇到这样的事情，塔吉多还需要一段时间思考一下吧。
Content.LocalizedString: This must be the first time Taygedo has faced something like this. I suppose he needs some time to process it all.

Content.SourceString: 作为同伴，或许我们也能帮帮塔吉多。
Content.LocalizedString: As companions, perhaps we could offer Taygedo some support.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师有什么好办法吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Any bright ideas, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 给塔吉多的晚饭多加几个大海胆吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's add some extra sea urchins to Taygedo's dinner tonight.

Content.SourceString: 多宽慰塔吉多几句？
Content.LocalizedString: Should I say a few words to comfort Taygedo?

Content.SourceString: 带塔吉多去散散心吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's take Taygedo out for a change of scenery.

Content.SourceString: 有海胆加餐的话，塔吉多说不定会开心一点。
Content.LocalizedString: With some sea urchins as a special treat, Taygedo might cheer up a bit.

Content.SourceString: 向朋友倾诉心情，是个缓解情绪的好办法
Content.LocalizedString: Opening up to friends about your feelings is an excellent way to ease emotional stress.

Content.SourceString: 有朋友陪在身边缓解烦恼，是个好办法。
Content.LocalizedString: Having friends by your side to help ease your troubles is indeed a good approach.

Content.SourceString: 用美食来抚慰心情，是个不错的选择。
Content.LocalizedString: Using food to soothe the soul is indeed a fine choice.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师稍等片刻。
Content.LocalizedString: Please wait a moment, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 疑惑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: （五分钟后）
Content.LocalizedString: (Five minutes later)

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多原来是去采买零件了，一些重要零件需要早点去才能买到。
Content.LocalizedString: It turns out Taygedo went to purchase some components. Certain important parts can only be acquired with an early visit.

Content.SourceString: 据塔吉多所说，上次清扫随心泥花费许久，它正打算发明一台新机器，用于清扫类似的大面积脏污。
Content.LocalizedString: According to Taygedo, cleaning up the Imaginadough last time took quite a while. He's now planning to invent a new machine specifically designed for cleaning similar large-scale messes.

Content.SourceString: 对于上次造成的麻烦，塔吉多很是抱歉，希望再遇到这样的情况时能有更快善后的方法。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo deeply apologizes for the trouble caused last time and hopes to develop faster cleanup methods should we encounter similar situations in the future.

Content.SourceString: 清理一整个湛望角的随心泥这种事还是不要有第二次了。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's hope we never have to clean Imaginadough from all over Azure Vista ever again.

Content.SourceString: 看来塔吉多没受什么影响。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like Taygedo isn't bothered by any of this.

Content.SourceString: 也是好事。
Content.LocalizedString: That's probably for the best.

Content.SourceString: 不过晚饭依旧可以给塔吉多加一个海胆。
Content.LocalizedString: But we can still add a sea urchin to Taygedo's dinner tonight.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师现在方便来一趟伊波恩的大厅吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, are you free to come to Eibon's hall right now?

Content.SourceString: 有些事又要麻烦鉴定师了。
Content.LocalizedString: I need to trouble you with something again, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 有空，我现在就过来。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm free, I'll head over right now.

Content.SourceString: 可能要晚一点到。
Content.LocalizedString: I might be a bit late.

Content.SourceString: 那就多谢鉴定师了。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you very much then, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 无妨，鉴定师先行处理手里要紧的事。
Content.LocalizedString: That's fine, Appraiser. Please handle your urgent matters first.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师还记得上次提到的小物它们遇到的麻烦吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you still remember the troubles those little things were having that I mentioned last time, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 有眉目了？
Content.LocalizedString: There's been progress?

Content.SourceString: 嗯，发现了不少线索。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, we've found quite a few clues.

Content.SourceString: 我马上到。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll be right there.
